name: No-Churn Mango Ice Cream

instructions.primary_message: In a food processor or blender, process heavy cream, stopping and scraping down sides of processor jar as needed for even blending, until thickened and soft peaks form, 30 to 60 seconds.
Add condensed milk and 1 1/2 cups mango puree and process until well combined,10 to 20 seconds.

Pour mixture into a loaf pan, 20-cm square baking pan or dish, or large metal or glass bowl. Drizzle remaining 1/4 cup mango puree over top and gently swirl into cream mixture using tines of a fork to create a swirl pattern. Press plastic wrap flush against surface and freeze until frozen and firm, at least 6 hours.

schema_metadata.keywords: mango ice cream recipe, no-churn ice cream

description: This creamy, bright-tasting mango ice cream comes together in minutes. No machine, eggs, or custard required. The secret? Sweetened condensed milk.
notes: Total time, including resting: 6 hr 10 min.
author: Swetha Sivakumar
